data.name: Love Rebirth: Rebellion
data.detailed_description:
From Corporate Hunter to Cyber Goddess!

 

Revenge or Romance? Four Fates Await. Their hearts are your new currency.

 

You've received an invitation to the ultimate, high-stakes game—a deadly card table where the winners gain a new life, and the losers are systematically erased.

 

Stepping into this shadow world are four captivating Love Interests, each with their own secrets and seductive charm. They may be your most reliable allies, or they could be the very traps set to make you lose this life-or-death scenario, you have only one choice: Win.

 

Bet your life. Bet their love.

 

Your charm is your weapon. Their hearts are your stakes. Use your wits and allure to dismantle a sprawling cyber conspiracy, all while pursuing the perfect romance. You will personally pen this epic of romantic revenge, rising from a mere hunter in the corporate shadows to a dazzling, all-powerful figure.

 

Will you walk this path alone, or will you command the devotion of four powerful men? The choice is yours. Write your own Otome ending.

 

◤ IMMERSIVE ROMANCE, UNRIVALED FREEDOM ◢

Dive into a relationship system with unparalleled freedom. Develop multiple romances simultaneously, unlocking exclusive storylines, intimate dialogues, customized outfitting, and even the choice to live together.

 

Every flutter of the heart can change the course of the story. Every act of betrayal could send you spiraling into the abyss.

 

◤ LIFE-ALTERING DECISIONS THAT SHAPE THE WORLDLINE ◢

Will you lead your comrades in a tidal wave of revolution? Go lone wolf to expose the truth and become a legend? Or accept the megacorp's terms and achieve "Eternal Life" on a higher plane?

 

Over 30 distinct endings await your exploration. The fate of the world is a variable—and you are the constant.

 

◤ MEET THEM: FORGE DEEP BONDS IN A WEB OF DESTINY ◢

 

Hermis | The Dual-Faced Awakened Synthetic

“At least don’t let yourself lose and walk away from this game.”

He is the charming, elegant waiter in the casino and the revolutionary lurking in the shadows. His frivolous smile hides an intense desire for freedom, and only to you does he show his authentic, gentle side.

 

Raven | The Gently Aloof, Mysterious Hacker

“Do you want to taste the truth? Its flavor... is like bitter almond.”

Once a data analyst for the Corporation, he now operates as an informant on the dark web. He possesses the rare ability to "taste" data, and he is only willing to decrypt those encrypted heartbeats for you.

 

Noctua | The Amnesiac, Loyal Clean-up Captain

“Survival probability increased by 72%—that is my personal guarantee.”

He was once the Corporation's sharpest blade, ordered to hunt you down. But after you shatter the loyalty chip in his mind, this powerful, bewildered soul pours all his protective instinct into you, and you alone.

 

Seven | The Slum Doctor Who Heals Scars with a Smile

“Smile more often. Sadness, you know, can corrode the brain.”

He is a sunflower blooming in the ruins, guarding the last sanctuary with his street-smart medical skills. His clinic is your safe harbor, and he is willing to use all his warmth to illuminate your shattered world.

data.short_description: This is a story-driven adventure focused on player choice and psychological immersion. Your decisions shape relationships, influence the narrative, and lead to multiple endings within a richly atmospheric cyberpunk world. This experience prioritizes story and emotional tension.
data.supported_languages:
Simplified Chinese*, English*, Japanese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-8500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVDIA RTX 1080 Ti,AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 32 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10,Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-8500
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVDIA RTX 3090,AMD Radeon RX 6750 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 64 GB available space
